description: This file is a test suite for the WiFi-related functions of the NetworkManager plugin, using Google Test framework to mock dependencies and verify behavior.

classes.name: NetworkManagerWifiTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing WiFi functionalities using Google Test. Sets up mock dependencies, initializes plugin infrastructure, and cleans up after tests.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test to verify that all expected methods are registered and available in the handler.

methods.name: get_wifi_device_devices_null
methods.description: Test case for handling the scenario where no WiFi devices are found (null device list).

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Test that disconnection with a device already in disconnected state returns success.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed
methods.description: Test disconnect behavior when the device is already connected.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed_errorCode
methods.description: Test disconnect behavior with different error codes when disconnecting.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_success
methods.description: Test disconnect behavior when the device is connected, and disconnection succeeds.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_deviceError
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID when device information retrieval results in an error or device is unmanaged.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotConnected
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID when device is activated but not connected to an access point.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotNull
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID with a valid connected access point, returning detailed info.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_psk
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID when connected using WPA-PSK security, returning detailed network info.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_EAP
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID when connected using EAP security, returning detailed network info.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_ssidNull
methods.description: Test GetConnectedSSID when SSID string is empty, ensuring proper handling.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Disconnect
methods.description: Test retrieving WiFi state when device is disconnected.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connected
methods.description: Test retrieving WiFi state when device is connected.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Pairing
methods.description: Test retrieving WiFi state when device is in pairing process.

methods.name: GetWifiState_unknown
methods.description: Test retrieving WiFi state for an unknown or unsupported device state.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connecting
methods.description: Test WiFi state when device is in connecting process.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Disabled
methods.description: Test WiFi state when device is disabled or unmanaged.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_Failed
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan when device is not in a suitable state, expecting failure.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_SSIDList
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan with a specified SSID list.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_Frequency
methods.description: Test starting WiFi scan with a specified frequency.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_failed_with_error
methods.description: Test handling of WiFi scan request failure due to hardware or interface issues.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_success
methods.description: Test a successful WiFi scan request.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_option_success
methods.description: Test requesting WiFi scan with additional options successfully.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_long_ssid
methods.description: Test connection attempt with an excessively long SSID string.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_device_null
methods.description: Test connection attempt where the known device cannot be found (null device).

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection
methods.description: Test failure when attempting to activate a known connection when no connection is established.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection_null
methods.description: Test failure with null connection ID when activating a known connection.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_type_null
methods.description: Test failure when the connection type of a known connection is null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed
methods.description: Test failure during the activation of a known connection.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_success
methods.description: Test successful activation of a known connection.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_same_ssid
methods.description: Test connection attempt with the same SSID that the device was previously connected to.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_Ap_list_null
methods.description: Test connection attempt when access points list is null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_no_access_point
methods.description: Test connection attempt when no access points are available.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_different_ssid
methods.description: Test connection attempt with a different SSID than previously connected.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_deviceFailed
methods.description: Test adding to known SSIDs with device in unmanaged state, expecting failure.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_SmallPssword
methods.description: Test adding to known SSIDs with a very short passphrase.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_failed
methods.description: Test adding SaaE network, expecting failure during mock add connection.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_success
methods.description: Test successful update of existing SaaE network.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_failed
methods.description: Test failure during SaaE network update.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_success
methods.description: Test successful addition of a SaaE network.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_connectionFailed
methods.description: Test failure mode when retrieving connections results in failure.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Test removing known SSIDs, expecting failure when connections cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_false
methods.description: Test removal of an SSID that does not exist, expecting success with false.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_true
methods.description: Test successful removal of an existing SSID.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_conn_id_null
methods.description: Test removal when connection ID is null, expecting success as fallback.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_ssid_specified_not_found
methods.description: Test removal with specified SSID not found, expecting failure.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_ssid_specified_found
methods.description: Test removal with specified SSID found and successfully deleted.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Test starting WPS, expecting success, called twice.
